source_snapshot.criteria: Physical state is LinkUp while up, Disabled while down and normal after five cycles.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Keep operator-controlled five-cycle IB transitions, exact port map, per-cycle state/LED evidence, isolation and recovery.

old_problem: The active five-cycle IB test lacked exact device/port/BDF/connector/peer identity, approved flap mechanism, LinkUp/Disabled transition deadlines, traffic isolation, alternate access, per-cycle LED/log evidence and restoration. A static ibstat snapshot could not prove disable or recovery durability.
disposition_reason: The required physical-state transitions and five-cycle scope are explicit. ED-03 permits topology/timing values as configuration, ED-05 keeps InfiniBand separate from Ethernet, ED-09 assigns physical/critical link control to an operator, and ED-19 retains each port and transition. No new engineering decision is needed solely for runtime bindings.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row395 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2987 and unique variant.
Separated commanded/fixture down/up actions, ibstat Physical state, logical port state and physical LED evidence for the same mapped InfiniBand port.
Retained LinkUp, Disabled, exactly five cycles per port, final normal state, 10-minute allocations and full untruncated IB evidence; Ethernet status is not substituted.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row396 and verified its manifest identity; no interface, cable, ibstat or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Five-cycle per-port InfiniBand LinkUp/Disabled and recovery verification
test_case.purpose: Prove each mapped BlueField InfiniBand port transitions to the signed LinkUp and Disabled physical states through five controlled down/up cycles, shows the expected physical indication and returns to stable fabric operation.
required_package: Approved OS administrative or physical fixture flap mechanism for each port
Five-cycle dwell, LinkUp/Disabled transition deadline, logical-state/rate and allowed-counter oracle
Hardware LED legend, qualified operator and timestamped visual evidence method
Fabric workload isolation, independent management/OOB, maintenance and restoration/recovery
test_case.test_command: With the exact IB map, isolation and alternate management verified, preserve full ibstat/state/counter/log baseline. A qualified operator applies the approved down then up mechanism to one mapped IB port for exactly five indexed cycles while complete target-bound ibstat and `/sys/class/infiniband/<device>/ports/<port>/state` data and physical LED observations are timestamped; after cycle five verify original link rate, peer/fabric health and traffic are restored.
test_case.expected_result: For every mapped IB port and all five cycles, the down action produces the signed Disabled physical state within deadline and the up action produces LinkUp plus the expected logical/rate/LED state within deadline; no disallowed errors or cross-port impact occurs and final fabric operation is normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires ten attributable state transitions per port, complete cycle-indexed ibstat/sysfs/log data, signed timing/state rules, required visual evidence and final restoration. A single Active/LinkUp snapshot, Ethernet state, grep-only output or fewer than five cycles cannot pass.
safety_gate: Isolate InfiniBand workloads and prove independent management before any flap
Operate only the mapped IB device/port/connector; never use an Ethernet interface or broad first-device selection
Qualified operator controls physical/critical link action and preserves full per-cycle fabric/system logs
Stop on wrong port, unexpected fabric traffic impact, timeout, error escalation or failed restoration; restore once and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Complete IB GUID/device/port/BDF/physical/peer map and flap mechanism
Baseline fabric/traffic/link/rate/counter state and alternate-access proof
Five indexed Disabled/LinkUp state pairs with complete ibstat/sysfs/log data per port
Timestamped physical LED/operator evidence under the approved legend
Final original rate, peer/fabric/traffic health and error-counter comparison
test_case.recovery: On a failed LinkUp or unexpected fabric impact, stop remaining cycles, use alternate management, restore only the affected IB port's approved administrative/cable state once, verify peer/subnet/fabric/rate/traffic health and preserve the failed cycle. Do not use Ethernet recovery or retry automatically.
